text: {"label":"Depression and Emotional Disorders Treatment","definition":"Behavioral accounts, assessment, and treatment of depression and related emotional disorders, including behavioral activation, reward responsiveness, distress tolerance, experiential avoidance, and acceptance-based or transdiagnostic therapies for adults and children.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on depression and mood-related distress rather than serious mental illness in psychiatric settings, panic-focused anxiety and exposure treatment, or the general scope of clinical behavior analysis."}
